info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Mortgage Loans Preapprovals-v5-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loans Preapproval List API provides users with access to a comprehensive list of preapproved mortgage loans. This API enables clients, such as lenders and mortgage brokers, to retrieve essential information regarding available preapprovals, including key details like interest rates and loan amounts. Typical use cases include displaying preapproval options on customer-facing platforms or integrating with internal systems for streamlined loan processing. This API serves as a vital resource for facilitating informed decision-making in the mortgage application process.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to request preapproval for a loan. It provides the necessary details to determine eligibility and terms for potential borrowers.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a preapproval process for a loan. It contains the necessary details required to assess the borrower's eligibility and provide a preliminary approval decision.

200.description: Successful retrieval of preapproval loan information.

ListMortgageLoansPreapprovalsRequest.title: Preapproval Request Body
ListMortgageLoansPreapprovalsRequest.description: This schema represents the required request body for a GET operation on loans preapproval.

ListMortgageLoansPreapprovalsResponse_20.description: Response schema for the preapproval operation, which indicates the status and details of the preapproval request.
